main_body: Grey iron anvil: wide flat working face on top, tapered waist, dark base with a lighter foot highlight. A small glowing orange/red piece sits on top.
top_band: Light grey at rows ~5-6 (about 2 rows) with a pale highlight edge, immediately followed by a mid-grey gradient that is the front face. The orange/red bits above it are a small object resting on the anvil, not its top.
evidence: Down the middle column there is a thin light-grey strip about 2 rows tall, then the waist and base seen straight on. The top reads as a rim or edge rather than a foreshortened surface. There is no distinct front-edge line and no eave shadow, and the body is a symmetric silhouette. This is a front elevation with a thin light cap, so it fails the 3/4 contract.

style.evidence: The anvil uses about 3 grey steps with a neutral near-black dark body and outline. The waist and base are large flat dark fills with no grain, dots or per-material texture. Next to the stall and well, which carry many colours per tile and tinted outlines, it looks thin and sticker-like. Only the small orange glow adds any variety.
